name: Kodak Portra 160
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA 160 Film, publication E-4051 (February 2016)

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure, Status M densitometry, Log H Ref -1.051.
notes.sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/50 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Diffuse spectral density, typical densities for D-min and a midscale neutral subject (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Print Grain Index (not rms granularity): diffuse-printing illumination, 14 in viewing distance; 25 is the visual threshold, 4 units one just-noticeable difference.
